gucs.long_description: Auto currently selects direct. Reconstruct performs full validation. Oversized inputs retain the legacy fallback regardless of this setting.
gucs.name: stannum.experimental_vacuum_merge_strategy
gucs.short_description: Experimental VACUUM merge strategy for controlled comparisons

gucs.long_description: A fold happens before either the byte or document cap is exceeded. A single oversized document is allowed.
gucs.name: stannum.write_buffer_bytes
gucs.short_description: Encoded bytes buffered before folding into a Stannum segment

gucs.long_description: Larger merges wait for VACUUM, including those that bring the directory back under max_segments; only the 128-entry on-disk bound forces the two smallest entries to merge above this budget. Zero defers every budgeted merge.
gucs.name: stannum.max_merge_docs
gucs.short_description: Document budget for ordinary merges performed by one inserting backend per fold

gucs.long_description: Lower values fold sooner, producing more and smaller segments.
gucs.name: stannum.write_buffer_docs
gucs.short_description: Documents buffered before folding into a Stannum segment

gucs.long_description: Bounds build memory; lower values write more segments.
gucs.name: stannum.build_segment_docs
gucs.short_description: Documents an index build accumulates per Stannum segment

gucs.long_description: A soft bound: inserts merge the smallest entries within their budget, VACUUM without one. Tiered merges keep the count far lower. The on-disk directory holds at most 128 entries, a hard bound inserts enforce whatever the cost.
gucs.name: stannum.max_segments
gucs.short_description: Segments an index directory may hold before its smallest entries merge

gucs.long_description: Segments are tiered by document count in powers of this factor; a tier holding this many segments merges them into one segment of the next tier.
gucs.name: stannum.merge_tier_factor
gucs.short_description: Stannum segments per size tier before they merge

gucs.long_description: Must be identical on the primary and every standby, and unused by other extensions. Effective only with shared_preload_libraries.
gucs.name: stannum.wal_rmgr_id
gucs.short_description: Custom WAL resource manager id used for Stannum removal-horizon records

gucs.long_description: Off leaves the bitmap index scan path, which rechecks nothing either.
gucs.name: stannum.enable_custom_scan
gucs.short_description: Enable Stannum's custom scan nodes for ==> queries

column_comments.dictionary_pages: Pages intersected by every immutable segment's dictionary extents, whether or not this backend ever read them. EXPLAIN's Dictionary Pages Read counts only the pages a given scan actually pinned; the two differ by design and agree only for a fully-scanned index.

views.name: index_health
views.query: SELECT c.oid::regclass AS index, s.* FROM pg_class c CROSS JOIN LATERAL @extschema@.index_stats(c.oid) s WHERE c.relkind = 'i' AND c.relam = (SELECT oid FROM pg_am WHERE amname = 'stannum')
